description: PERMANENTLY FROZEN. A v1 client must be able to parse every future v1 announcement, or an obsolete build could never learn that it is obsolete. This field set therefore never grows; everything that varies between releases lives behind key_ring and manifest.

announcement_domain.description: must equal the domain compiled into the client; a different domain is never adopted from the network

key_id.description: names the release key that signed the inner manifest

sha256.description: lower-case hex; upper case is not canonical

size.description: canonical JSON carries integers only up to int64

url.description: HTTPS only; a signed artifact never points at plaintext

key_ring_epoch.description: monotonic; a raised epoch invalidates older rings immediately

sha256.description: lower-case hex; upper case is not canonical

size.description: canonical JSON carries integers only up to int64

url.description: HTTPS only; a signed artifact never points at plaintext

release_sequence.description: ordered within the domain; strictly greater is newer, equal is current, lower is discarded
